title: 🔅🔅TURKMENBASHI, October 9, 2026 — Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian held separate meetings with Azerbaijani President Ilham Aliyev and Turkmen President Serdar Berdimuhamedov on the sidelines of the Commonwealth of Independent States (CIS) summit and a Caspian environmental summit in Turkmenbashi.
text: 🔅🔅TURKMENBASHI, October 9, 2026 — Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian held separate meetings with Azerbaijani President Ilham Aliyev and Turkmen President Serdar Berdimuhamedov on the sidelines of the Commonwealth of Independent States (CIS) summit and a Caspian environmental summit in Turkmenbashi.
